notes.aliased_field: ioc.value is aliased; no raw indicator appears in the bundle
notes.export_policy: built with config/lite-export-policy.yaml, this node's default profile
notes.stale_row_excluded: 203.0.113.99 predates the freshness window and must be absent

dataset.citation: MITRE ATT&CK technique, as ingested into azazel-knowledge intel.attack_technique
dataset.confidence_ceiling: not a scored claim; carries no confidence and must not be treated as evidence of anything
dataset.decay: reference material is not scored and does not decay
dataset.expiry: does not expire on a clock; a row is superseded when this node ingests a later attack_version
dataset.freshness: static reference material: versioned, not dated; the pinned attack_version is the freshness statement
dataset.limitations: a technique label is a description, not an attribution and not a recommendation (ADR-0015 D7)
dataset.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise, pinned to the attack_version carried on each row

dataset.decay: confidence decays with age per docs/scoring.md; a consumer may lower it, never raise it
dataset.generation: the intel_generation recorded in this bundle's profile.selection_inputs
dataset.limitations: advisory only; carries no enforcement authority, no activation, and no command (ADR-0015 D7)
dataset.source: aggregated feed intake across this node's configured feeds; per-feed attribution is not exported by the default policy

dataset.citation: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue, as ingested into azazel-knowledge intel.kev
dataset.confidence_ceiling: a catalogue membership statement, not a scored claim; presence is binary and carries no confidence
dataset.decay: a KEV listing does not decay: an exploited vulnerability does not become less exploited with time
dataset.expiry: entries are not withdrawn on a clock; a row is superseded when this node ingests a later catalog_version
dataset.generation: carried by the intel_generation of the artifact; the catalogue is replaced wholesale, never patched
dataset.limitations: says a CVE is known-exploited somewhere, not that it is present or exploitable here (ADR-0015 D7)
dataset.source: CISA KEV, pinned to the catalog_version carried on each row
